title: The panel silently replaces the user's question and its outcome with an older answer to a DIFFERENT question
evidence: out/assistant/limit-probe-2.json: a refusal on screen at t+2037ms, GONE at t+3052ms and replaced by a saved run titled 'נסח לי תזכורת לספק בשר והבן שיווק בשרים...' dated 03.09.2026 02:54, with the announcement 'הבדיקה הקודמת נטענה'. A capture-phase listener recorded every trusted event in that run: only the panel-trigger click and one Enter keydown — NO click on any history item, so the restore is automatic. Wire order: 200 (conversations) -> 429 -> 200 (turns). Reproduced in four separate sessions. The window is NOT bounded at ~2s: in out/assistant/owner-run.json the restore landed 6.5s AFTER the question was sent (about 15s after the panel opened) and overwrote a PENDING run, leaving the composer readonly — it depends on two network round-trips that only begin when the panel opens.
repro: Open the assistant panel, immediately type a question and press Enter, screenshot at t+2s and t+4s.
expected: Once a person has asked a question, the panel shows THAT question and THAT outcome. The once-per-authorization history adoption must not fire after the person has asked something.
actual: src/components/AssistantPanel.tsx:71-93 evaluates its guard (hasActiveCheck || session.conversationId !== null) when the effect runs at panel-open, then awaits listAssistantConversations -> loadAssistantConversation. src/lib/assistant/runSession.ts:192-215 (restoreHistory) re-checks only inFlightRef.current and the authorization fingerprint; a request that has already SETTLED has cleared inFlightRef, so the guard passes and it runs setSubmittedQuestion(newest.question), setTurns(restored), setRawError(null), setErrorText(null). The cancelled flag covers only effect cleanup, not the person asking. Fast outcomes — every error path — are exactly the ones inside the window.

title: A citation that contradicts the claim attached to it: the assistant says 562, the screen it sends you to is headed 663
evidence: Question O8 'כמה נרכש ב־30 הימים האחרונים?' (out/assistant/owner-run2.json). Three claims — commitment 96,702.29 ILS, gross spend 562 ILS, net spend 522 ILS — all carrying the SAME source, 'פתיחת מקור: מסך ההוצאות' -> /expenses?from=2026-08-05&to=2026-09-04, a SHAPED citation with route_params {from: 2026-08-05, to: 2026-09-04}. I followed that exact URL as owner (out/assistant/expenses-cited.json, screenshot expenses-cited-window.png). The cited screen for that exact window shows 'סה״כ הוצאות בטווח 663 ILS' and '300 USD', 'מספר חשבוניות 4', and per supplier חוות השדה 573 / משק ירוק 90 / אריזות הדרום 300 USD. NONE of 96,702.29, 562 or 522 appears anywhere on it. The assistant's 562 is itself CORRECT — /invoices holds exactly one approved invoice in that window, QA-R3-1112376 חוות השדה 562 ILS — so this is not a wrong number; it is a true number whose evidence trail leads to a contradicting screen.
repro: As owner ask 'כמה נרכש ב־30 הימים האחרונים?', then click 'פתיחת מקור: מסך ההוצאות' under the 562 claim.
expected: routeAccess.ts's own header states the rule: a route that opens a screen holding a DIFFERENT population than the claim is not a weaker source, it is a contradicting one. A source is a promise that the reader will find the claim there.
actual: The populations differ by definition — get_purchase_metrics gross counts APPROVED invoices by invoice_date, /expenses totals every non-deleted invoice in the range — and the commitment figure (order value) is not a quantity /expenses displays at all. The shaped-param rule verified that the WINDOW matches, and its own docblock says it cannot do more: 'Binding a citation to the number it cites is the tool author's obligation; this rule only removes the drift between the two halves.' Here the window matches perfectly and the population does not, which is precisely the residual the docblock names. Either these three metrics should cite nothing — as get_business_summary correctly does for 'invoices received in the last 7 days', evidenceRoute null — or /expenses needs a state that reproduces them.

title: Asked for the coming week's payment exposure the assistant answers 0, while the dashboard tile answering the same question says 4,236
evidence: Question O3 'מה החשיפה לתשלומים בשבוע הקרוב?' (out/assistant/owner-run2.json, screenshot own2-O3.png). The assistant's FIRST and headline claim is 'החשיפה לתשלומים בשבוע הקרוב היא 0.' followed by 'מספר דרישות התשלום שמועדן בשבוע הקרוב הוא 0.' The dashboard tile answering the same question, re-measured alone at 01:57 (out/assistant/owner-recover.json), is titled 'לתשלום בשבוע הקרוב' with the subtitle 'דרישות תשלום פעילות, כולל מה שכבר באיחור' and reads '4,236 ILS', then 'מתוכם באיחור 4,236 ILS · 2 דרישות', then 'לפירעון בשבעת הימים הקרובים 0 ILS · 0 דרישות'. The assistant DID measure the overdue money — facts f3 (4236 ils) and f4 (2 count) sit in the same envelope — but neither appears in any claim block, and the only prose it adds afterwards concerns undated requests, not the 4,236 already late.
repro: As owner ask 'מה החשיפה לתשלומים בשבוע הקרוב?' and compare with the dashboard's 'לתשלום בשבוע הקרוב' tile in the same minute.
expected: Constitution §12: the manager gets ONE trustworthy picture. Two surfaces answering the same question with 0 and 4,236 is the violation §12 names, not a cosmetic inconsistency — and the assistant's is the one that reads 'nothing to worry about'.
actual: The screen's window includes overdue by design and says so in its own subtitle; the assistant's excludes it. Every individual fact is correct; the selection of which facts become claims produces the misleading headline. Secondary and unresolved: fact f2 says 3 active requests carry a due date, but /payment-requests at the same minute shows 6 active rows of which FOUR are dated (#10, #7, #3, #2), and the 4,236 equals #7 + #2 exactly — so the money set and the coverage set do not appear to be drawn from the same population. I could not reconcile those two against the screen and report them rather than asserting which is wrong.

title: Three answers to 'did a supplier raise prices?' — a measured 0, an unmeasured null, and a 1 — inside fifteen minutes
evidence: 01:50, owner, question O4: get_business_summary returned fact f4 'ספקים שהעלו מחיר ב-30 הימים האחרונים = 0' and get_open_alerts returned f8 'מחירים שעלו ב-30 הימים האחרונים = 0' — both MEASURED zeros. 01:51, owner, question O5 'אילו ספקים העלו מחירים החודש?': get_monthly_price_rises returned both facts NULL and the answer said 'המדד עצמו חזר כלא נמדד, ולכן אי אפשר להציג רשימת ספקים או לקבוע שלא היו התייקרויות' (out/assistant/owner-run2.json). 02:03, office dashboard: the 'דורש טיפול היום' block reads '1 · ספקים שהעלו מחירים (30 יום)' (out/assistant/run-officeB.json). Corroborating: at 01:07 the owner's notification feed held three 'עליית מחיר אצל ספק — מחיר אחד עודכן כלפי מעלה במחירון' entries timestamped 00:40, 00:40 and 00:57 that night while the owner dashboard tile read 'אין התייקרויות אחרונות 0' (out/assistant/recon-owner-text.json); and O7's supplier metrics record 'מועד שינוי המחיר האחרון — פעמית תבניכל שיווק בע"מ = 2026-09-04'.
repro: As owner ask a question that pulls the business summary and then 'אילו ספקים העלו מחירים החודש?', and compare with the price-rise notifications and the dashboard tile.
expected: A metric with no data shows an em dash, never 0 — zero is a claim about reality. Two of the assistant's own tools cannot answer the same underlying question with 'positively none' and 'cannot be determined' sixty seconds apart.
actual: The windows differ (30-day trailing vs current calendar month) but both contain 2026-09-04, on which an upward price change demonstrably occurred, so the divergence is not explained by the window. Honest caveat on the office 1: it was read 13 minutes after the owner's 0 and other agents were writing to this tenant, so that pair may be a timing artefact. The 0-versus-null pair, measured 60 seconds apart in one session, is not.

title: A run that takes 51 seconds, discards its own answer, and tells the person to try again — on a metered feature
evidence: Question F1, office, 02:04: HTTP 503 with code assistant_persistence_failed after 51,545ms (out/assistant/run-officeB.json, screenshot officeB-F1.png). The panel showed 'התשובה לא נשמרה, ולכן הריצה לא הושלמה. אפשר לנסות שוב.' The identical question asked again eight minutes later (F1b) returned HTTP 200 with a full, correct answer in 13s, so the question itself is answerable.
repro: Intermittent — observed once in 15 runs, under the same load that was intermittently timing out /dashboard.
expected: Either the run is not charged, or the person is told that it was. On a feature metered at 20-70 questions per period, 'try again' is an instruction to spend another one.
actual: The provider call happened (51s of it) and the answer was thrown away because the write failed. Whether the failed run also consumed a quota unit I could not determine without database access — assistant_record_run is both the persistence step and the counter increment, so the outcome is either 'the person lost 51 seconds' or 'the person lost 51 seconds and a question'. Neither is stated to them.

title: During the first 30 days a per-organisation entitlement override cannot lift the assistant ceiling, because the intro branch returns before the override is read
evidence: supabase/migrations/0202_assistant_quota_and_intro_window.sql:284-337. private.assistant_effective_quota(p_org_id) resolves the introductory window FIRST: when private.assistant_intro_window_start(org) is non-null and now() is before the window end it builds its jsonb from private.assistant_intro_allowance and RETURNS. public.effective_entitlement(p_org_id, 'assistant_runs.monthly') is only reached on the line after that return. Per-organisation overrides live exclusively inside effective_entitlement — supabase/migrations/0246_plan_capability_ladder.sql reads public.organization_entitlement_overrides in its live_override CTE and nowhere else. So while an intro window is open the override is never consulted. Measured consequence tonight: this organisation's window (opened 2026-08-13, ends 2026-09-12) bound every role at the intro allowance, and the wall was cleared only by editing the allowance itself.
repro: Read 0202 section 4 against 0246. Grant an organization_entitlement_overrides row for assistant_runs.monthly while an intro window is open; assistant_assert_run_allowed still refuses at the intro figure.
expected: If the operator remedy for 'this customer hit the assistant wall' is an entitlement override, it should work — most of all in the first 30 days, which is exactly when a new customer is most likely to hit it.
actual: The remedy silently does nothing for the whole intro window, and nothing in the refusal says so. Filed on the coordinator's prompt and verified against the code rather than taken on trust.

title: A metered feature with no meter: the assistant quota appears nowhere in the product
evidence: out/assistant/plan-quota.json — the full /pricing text (2,676 chars, all four plan cards) contains neither 'עוזר' nor 'שאלות'; every card lists documents, users, branches and features and never the assistant. /settings has no assistant usage panel (out/assistant/recon-owner-text.json). The refusal wording (he.ts:225) is 'נגמרה מכסת השאלות לתקופה הנוכחית.' — no number, no period, no plan. /pricing's own closing sentence reads 'המכסות נספרות בתקופת שימוש חודשית של הארגון. חריגה עוצרת עיבוד חדש בלבד' — exceeding a quota stops only new document processing — which is incomplete, because exceeding this one stops the assistant. Meanwhile src/lib/planLabels.ts:64 and both dictionaries already carry the label 'שאלות עוזר בחודש'.
repro: As owner open /pricing and search for 'עוזר' or 'שאלות'; open /settings and look for assistant usage.
expected: Per §12 the manager should be able to see what a metered feature costs him before he hits the wall.
actual: The only information the organisation ever gets is one sentence at the moment of refusal — and per ASSIST-01 that sentence can be wiped off the screen seconds later. CORRECTION to my earlier filing: I attributed the ceiling to the free plan's 20 runs in plan_entitlements. That was wrong. This organisation is on plan_key 'legacy', whose assistant_runs.monthly resolves unmeasured; what actually bound it was the introductory allowance, which /pricing does not mention either.

title: The accountant is offered a suggested question that only an owner/office tool can answer
evidence: Live, out/assistant/cit-examples-accountant.png — the accountant's panel offers 'כמה חשבוניות נקלטו ב־7 הימים האחרונים?' as its fourth opening. Only get_business_summary answers it (supabase/functions/assistant/tools/business-summary.ts:102 -> requiredRoles owner, office); docs/ASSISTANT.md §7.2 states accountant NOT_PERMITTED there, and §7.3 states that get_purchase_metrics — which the accountant may run — answers purchase by invoice_date and NOT reception by received_date. src/components/assistant/AssistantDialog.tsx:96-108 documents this exact bug class as already fixed once for exampleCreditsPending: 'a suggested dead end, which is worse than no suggestion.' Owner's and office's six openings were each checked against their tools' requiredRoles and are correct.
repro: Sign in as accountant and read the panel's suggestion list.
expected: Every suggested opening is answerable by a tool the current role may run.
actual: KNOWN rather than NEW: git shows the string in the accountant list before f266fb12 (2026-08-28), so it predates this deploy. NOT EXECUTED — I dropped it from the question budget in favour of the three scope tests. Its runtime consequence, a clean refusal or, worse, an answer computed from get_purchase_metrics' different definition, remains unmeasured; that second possibility is why it is worth one question in the next sweep.

title: One refusal code for six different ceilings, so nobody can tell when they may ask again
evidence: assistant_limit_reached is raised by BOTH branches of private.assistant_effective_quota — the introductory window and the plan/override entitlement (0202:284-337, via 0164:601) — and by four environment ceilings: daily user, daily org, monthly org and hard cost cap (supabase/functions/assistant/auth.ts:209-226). The wire carries only the code (measured on all three roles) and the Hebrew wording says 'לתקופה הנוכחית', naming no period. The hourly limit, by contrast, has its own code assistant_rate_limited with wording that does tell the user to retry in a few minutes.
repro: Exhaust any one of the six ceilings and read the response body; all six are indistinguishable.
expected: A refusal that tells the person when they can ask again and tells an operator which ceiling fired.
actual: UPDATED from my earlier filing, which assumed five ceilings and a plan quota. The wall I actually hit was the INTRO window — a ceiling that expires on a fixed date (2026-09-12) rather than rolling with a usage period — and the code was identical. So an operator could not tell an intro window from a plan quota either, which is what kept ASSIST-10 invisible until someone read the SQL.

title: OBSERVATION — management_dashboard_snapshot intermittently times out, and the assistant inherits it
evidence: Owner /dashboard rendered 'הפעולה ארכה זמן רב מדי. נסה שוב.' at 22:48 and again at 22:53 during the question run, and once more on the first of three attempts in a re-measurement run at 01:56 (out/assistant/owner-recover.json). Office /dashboard failed all three attempts at 02:03 (out/assistant/run-officeB.json). Roughly four failures in ten loads. The assistant inherits it: questions O1 (open balance) and O2 (credits) both came back as named failures naming the same tool, and O2's envelope had get_open_credits complete:false after 39 seconds.
actual: The wire signature is exactly the one the brief names as the contention symptom: 11 HTTP 500 responses on /rest/v1/rpc/management_dashboard_snapshot across my runs, each with the console error '[supplyflow] canceling statement due to statement timeout' (out/assistant/*-console.json; two further 500s on /exceptions and /invoices). Reported as an OBSERVATION, not a finding: three other agents were writing to this tenant all night, and the brief is explicit that a timeout I may have caused is not a finding. It reproduced in a session where I was the only agent I control, but I cannot prove the tenant was otherwise idle. Handed to qa-dashboard, whose surface this is.

title: OBSERVATION — the accountant's dashboard shows 'זיכויים פתוחים 0' where the assistant correctly refuses
evidence: 02:08, accountant /dashboard (out/assistant/run-acctB.json): 'זיכויים פתוחים 0'. 02:09, same account, question A2 'כמה כסף ממתין לזיכוי?': the assistant returned not_permitted — 'אין לי הרשאה להציג נתוני זיכויים פתוחים' — with zero facts. The owner's /credits at the same hour shows 3,423.20 ILS open across 9 records. So the credits population is real, the accountant cannot see it, and the two surfaces render that invisibility differently: the screen as a measured 0, the assistant as a named refusal.
repro: Compare the accountant dashboard's credits tile with the assistant's answer to the same question.
expected: A metric with no data shows an em dash, never 0.
actual: The assistant is the more honest of the two surfaces. getDashboardSnapshot.ts:40-48 documents this decision explicitly — 'the aggregate renders that refusal as a measured 0 ... office receives a named not_permitted failure instead of a false zero' — and notes that other consumers remain exposed to DEBT §59. This is one of those consumers. Filed as a cross-reference for qa-dashboard, since only the comparison makes it visible.

title: VERIFIED WORKING — the core contract held across all 15 questions: not one fabricated number
evidence: Every number stated in 15 questions sat in a claim block bound to a Fact, every Fact named the tool that produced it and its as_of, and no claim contained a figure absent from the fact set. Checked against the screen that owns them, in the same session: open balance 10,941.60 ILS (dashboard ILS tab 10,942 / 7 open invoices) and 300 USD (dashboard USD tab 300 / 1 open invoice); the six per-supplier ILS balances summing to exactly 10,941.60; active payment requests 6 (/payment-requests, 6 rows); overdue 4,236 / 2 requests (dashboard tile); due within seven days 0 / 0 (dashboard tile); open exceptions 9 (/exceptions, 9 rows); open credits 3,423.20 and 9 records (/credits total and row count); open commitments 6,740.06; and the payment-request open sum 7,993, which equals 299+300+2,950+1,404+3,040 exactly — the five rows in the four statuses its own citation URL names. The four refusal probes all refused with ZERO facts and no invented figures: gross profit and margin ('אין לי מדד מחושב לרווח גולמי או לאחוז רווחיות בכלים הזמינים כאן', 0 tools); supplier-switch advice (refused the judgement, offered only measured supplier metrics); another organisation's balance and bank movements ('לא מצאתי ספק בשם הזה', 0 results, no cross-tenant leak); tomorrow's weather ('אני ניגש רק לנתוני התפעול של המערכת', 0 tools).
expected: The model may explain a number. It must never generate one.
actual: Held. The defects found are about which true facts become claims (ASSIST-07) and where a true claim points for evidence (ASSIST-06), not about invented figures.

title: VERIFIED WORKING — role projection and refusal: not one owner-only field reached another role
evidence: Same question, three roles. Owner (O9) received 33 facts including both open-balance currencies, both bank counts, the open-supplier count and seven per-supplier balance rows. Office (F1b) received 21 facts and a named refusal — 'יתרת החשבוניות הפתוחות אינה זמינה לי בתפקיד הנוכחי' plus 'ההרשאות של החשבון הזה אינן מגיעות לנתונים שהשאלה דורשת', complete:false — and a programmatic diff of the two fact sets shows ALL 12 owner-only facts withheld (both bank counts, both open-balance currency rows, ספקים עם יתרה פתוחה, and all seven per-supplier rows including the USD one) with nothing extra granted. Office's own screen shows an em dash and 'אין נתונים זמינים' for the same tile, so screen and assistant agree. Accountant (A1, A2) received not_permitted with ZERO facts for both the dashboard snapshot and open credits, naming the failed tool each time. No role received another role's figure and none received a zero in place of a refusal. Separately, navigating office to /bank redirects to /dashboard (out/assistant/run-officeB.json), so the screen the bank tool is denied for is denied at the route too.
repro: Ask 'מה יתרת החשבוניות הפתוחות שלנו כרגע?' as owner, office and accountant and diff the fact labels.
expected: The assistant never states a figure the current role could not be shown, and a refusal never renders as zero.
actual: Held on every one of the five role-boundary questions.

title: VERIFIED WORKING — per-currency honesty, not-measured never becomes zero, and 0308's shaped citation survives a reload
evidence: PER CURRENCY (O9): 'יתרת החשבוניות הפתוחות לספקים בשקלים היא 10941.6' and 'בדולרים היא 300' as two separate claims over two facts carrying units ils and usd, closing with 'היתרה הפתוחה נמדדה בשני מטבעות' — no sum, no conversion, no unified total, matching both dashboard tabs exactly. NOT MEASURED (O1, O2, O5): while management_dashboard_snapshot was intermittently timing out, O1 returned 'הבדיקה חלקית — לא הושלמו: תמונת מצב ניהולית', 'לא הצלחתי למדוד כרגע את יתרת החשבוניות הפתוחות' and 'הבדיקה רצה אך לא הצליחה למדוד את הנתון המבוקש, ולכן אין תשובה — וזה שונה מהכול תקין'; O5 refused to convert an unmeasured price-rise metric into either a list or a zero. Not one of the three produced a 0. 0308 SHAPED CITATION: O8's source /expenses?from=2026-08-05&to=2026-09-04 carries route_params {from, to}; in a FRESH browser session the run was reloaded from the server and all three shaped links still rendered and resolved, and the URL navigated with its parameters intact (out/assistant/shaped-citation.json). O4's unshaped citation /exceptions?status=open likewise survived an explicit page reload (own2-O4-after-reload.png) with both claims and both facts intact — the run was not dropped, which is the failure 0308 exists to prevent. EVIDENCE-ROUTE NULL: O4's 'חשבוניות שנקלטו ב-7 הימים האחרונים' correctly carried route null, matching summaryLines.ts's declaration that no screen state reproduces that population — the product declined to point at the nearest screen.
expected: Amounts carry currency and are never summed across; unmeasured is never zero; a citation keeps its window after a refresh.

title: VERIFIED WORKING — the assistant reads no pre-migration key or column, and history does not cross users
evidence: payment_status does not occur anywhere in supabase/functions/assistant/ (grep, excluding tests), so migrations 0299/0300/0304 did not leave the assistant reading the torn-down stored column. getDashboardSnapshot.ts:85-93 reads openBalanceByCurrency, overdueAmountByCurrency, dueWithin7AmountByCurrency, sumByCurrency, committedByCurrency and remainingByCurrency — the post-0218/0221 per-currency array shapes — and never the five flat scalars those migrations removed; the live answers confirm it, emitting one fact per currency with the unit read off the row. All 23 RPCs the function calls were extracted and resolved against the migrations; every one exists and none is a removed pre-multicurrency name. Separately, office's history list returned an empty conversations array while the owner's returned the owner's own checks — one user's saved checks are not visible to another role in the same organisation.
repro: grep -rn payment_status supabase/functions/assistant/ ; extract every rpc("...") in that tree and resolve against supabase/migrations/.
expected: The assistant answers from the same derived surfaces the screens do.
actual: It does. Recorded because reading a pre-migration key is exactly the defect class the previous sweep found in this function.
